clauses.clause: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may have target creature get +2/+0 until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: Trace: the trigger fires at YOUR beginning of combat only ([attacks alone], [opp_giant blocks], [you_bear attacks]; none on the opponent's turn) and targets you_bear, but the probe's combat answerer declines the may ('skip' default), so no +2/+0 appears (you_bear still deals 2): the decline path is shown, the accept path is not. Tree = compiler template B2a-battle-rattle-shaman (OptionalEffect around MODIFY_PT +2/+0 EOT, any creature). Packs: battle_rattle_shaman_accept_pump.json (accept on your Bear -> 4/2, deals 4) PASS; battle_rattle_shaman_pump_wears_off.json (2/2 again after end of turn) PASS; battle_rattle_shaman_target_opponents_creature.json (an opponent's creature is a legal target, gets +2/+0) PASS.
